$description: LAYER 1 — PAGE MAX-WIDTH (all MFEs), Template B (Harvard-PLL / tels-mirror). Edit size.container.max-width.xl to change main content width everywhere. Applied by tels-content-width in paragon/overrides/_layout.scss + paragon/_header.scss / _footer.scss.

xl.$description: MAIN page max-width (change this) → --pgn-size-container-max-width-xl. Drives Learning/Discussion/Catalog/headers/footers platform-wide.

public.$description: PUBLIC MARKETING SITE ONLY max-width → --pgn-size-container-max-width-public. Used by .tels-container (paragon/overrides/_layout.scss). Kept separate from xl so future changes to one don't ripple into Learning/Studio/Discussion or vice versa.
